title: sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, version bump to v1.150.0
author: Asha Patel
description: Summary: This PR consolidates recent SDK changes across Python, TypeScript, and Go to achieve consistent auth retry semantics, improve streaming API ergonomics, and apply parity fixes prior to the v1.150.0 release. Motivation: multiple downstream teams observed inconsistent retry behavior between SDKs (token refresh vs 401 handling) and awkward streaming ergonomics in TS and Go client codepaths. This change set unifies the auth retry policy (exponential backoff with jitter, token-refresh-aware retries), standardizes streaming iterator APIs for better ergonomics, fixes parity gaps in options/headers across SDKs, and bumps SDK package versions to v1.150.0. Scope: - Python: refactor AuthTransport to centralize retry decision logic, add token refresh callback hook, adjust default retry limits to match other SDKs. Export a streaming helper generator that yields typed chunks and completes with final metadata. - TypeScript: change streaming client to return an async iterable with explicit Done event, add convenience onData/onEnd helpers for ergonomics, and align retry/backoff configuration with other SDKs. - Go: add RetryTransport wrapper that uses the same policy and supports context cancellation; modify streaming client API to return a channel and an ErrStreamClosed sentinel. - Tests: add unit tests validating retry-on-401 behavior, coverage for streaming end-of-stream metadata, and integration tests against the local canary serving endpoint. - Docs: update SDK reference for auth, streaming, and migration notes for v1.150.0. Checklist: [x] unify retry policy implementation across SDKs [x] add token refresh hook/usage docs [x] improve streaming ergonomics and docs [x] add unit and integration tests [x] bump package versions and changelogs Notes on compatibility: changes are additive ergonomics improvements; migration notes included for callers who relied on previous streaming callback shape. Rollout plan: merge to main, run cross-language integration job, release v1.150.0 packages, and monitor SDK telemetry for increased retry rates or unexpected errors.

release_notes: SDKs: v1.150.0. Unifies auth retry behavior across Python/TS/Go, adds token-refresh-aware retries, improves streaming ergonomics (async iterable / generator helpers in TS/Python and channel-based streaming in Go), parity fixes for headers/options, and minor bug fixes. See docs/sdk/auth.md and docs/sdk/streaming.md for migration guidance.
